title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications. However, effective evaluation and optimization require high-quality, diverse task datasets that are often difficult to obtain due to privacy and other constraints. Existing synthetic task generation methods often produce generic tasks that ignore an agent's underlying state or database and fail to reflect real-world usage diversity. We propose EdgeGen, a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from an agent's specification and uses them to generate database-grounded edge-case tasks designed to violate these rules. When combined with existing synthetic data generation techniques, EdgeGen enables agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization. The resulting pipeline forms a fully automated closed-loop system that requires no human annotation. Finetuning on data generated by EdgeGen yields a consistent mean progress improv

translated_title: EdgeGen：通过合成边缘用例生成，将工具调用智能体的能力提升至理想路径之外
translated_abstract: 调用工具的大语言模型智能体正日益广泛地部署于企业应用中。然而，有效的评估与优化需要高质量、多样化的任务数据集，而受隐私等因素限制，这类数据集往往难以获取。现有的合成任务生成方法通常产生通用任务，忽略了智能体底层的状态或数据库，无法反映真实世界使用场景的多样性。我们提出EdgeGen，一个合成任务生成框架，它从智能体的规范中提取合规规则，并利用这些规则生成旨在违反这些规则的、以数据库为基础的边缘用例任务。当与现有的合成数据生成技术相结合时，EdgeGen能够通过微调和测试框架优化来改进智能体。由此形成的流水线构成了一个完全自动化的闭环系统，无需任何人工标注。在EdgeGen生成的数据上进行微调，可带来持续稳定的平均进度提升。
tldr: EdgeGen是一个从智能体规范中提取合规规则、并据此生成基于数据库的边缘用例任务的合成数据框架，通过全自动闭环流水线实现无需人工标注的智能体微调与优化。
en_tdlr: EdgeGen is a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from agent specifications to create database-grounded edge-case tasks, enabling fully automated, annotation-free agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization.
